sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000000.0, 2) AS revenue_billion
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Microsoft'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022

SELECT 
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000.0, 2) AS capex_millions
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE 
    (c.name LIKE '%3M%' OR c.ticker = 'MMM')
    AND av.metric LIKE '%capital%'   -- captures capital expenditure metrics
    AND av.fiscal_year = 2018

SELECT 
    av.value AS total_assets,
    av.unit,
    av.fiscal_year
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Coca-Cola%'
  AND av.metric LIKE '%asset%'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022

SELECT ROUND(av.value, 2) AS diluted_eps_2021
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Verizon'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021
  AND av.metric LIKE '%diluted%eps%'

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000.0, 2) AS cash_millions
FROM companies AS c
JOIN annual_values AS av
    ON c.cik = av.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Pfizer'
  AND av.metric = 'cashAndCashEquivalents'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT 
    c.name   AS company,
    c.ticker AS ticker,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue_2022
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND c.ticker IN ('WMT', 'COST')
ORDER BY c.ticker

SELECT 
    av.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Nike'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
ORDER BY av.fiscal_year

SELECT 
    c.ticker,
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS net_loss
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.fiscal_year = 2020
  AND av.metric = 'net_income'
  AND av.value < 0
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT ROUND(AVG(av.value), 2) AS average_net_income
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.sector = 'Information Technology'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND av.metric = 'net_income'

WITH ms AS (
    SELECT av.value
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'Microsoft'
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2023
      AND av.metric LIKE '%operating%margin%'
)
SELECT ROUND(value, 2) AS operating_margin_percent
FROM ms

WITH adobe_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        av.fiscal_year,
        av.value AS revenue
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE 
        (c.name = 'Adobe' OR c.ticker = 'ADBE')
        AND av.metric = 'revenue'
        AND av.fiscal_year IN (2021, 2022)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN revenue END) -
         MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN revenue END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN revenue END) * 100,
        2
    ) AS revenue_growth_percent
FROM adobe_rev

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN av.metric IN ('cash_from_operations', 'OperatingCashFlow') 
                    THEN av.value 
                END) -
            SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN av.metric IN ('capital_expenditures', 'CapitalExpenditures', 'CapEx') 
                    THEN av.value 
                END)
        ) / 1000000.0,
        2
    ) AS free_cash_flow_millions
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'General Mills'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2020

SELECT
    cik,
    name,
    sec_name,
    sector,
    fiscal_year_end
FROM companies
WHERE ticker IS NULL OR ticker = ''
ORDER BY name

WITH gross_profit AS (
    SELECT cik, value
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'gross_profit' AND fiscal_year = 2022
),
gross_margin AS (
    SELECT cik, value
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'gross_margin' AND fiscal_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
    c.ticker,
    c.name,
    ROUND(gm.value, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM gross_margin gm
JOIN gross_profit gp ON gm.cik = gp.cik
JOIN companies c ON c.cik = gm.cik
ORDER BY gm.value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS net_profit_margin
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'netProfitMargin'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND c.sector = 'Consumer Staples'
ORDER BY net_profit_margin DESC

WITH rev2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        av.cik,
        av.value,
        c.sector,
        c.name,
        c.ticker
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'revenue' 
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
    sector,
    name,
    ticker,
    ROUND(value, 2) AS revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY value DESC) AS rn
    FROM rev2022
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sector

SELECT 
    c.name AS company_name,
    av.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue_as_reported,
    ROUND(av.latest_value, 2) AS latest_revenue
FROM companies AS c
JOIN annual_values AS av
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.ticker = 'MMM'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT
    cik,
    metric,
    ROUND(value, 2)        AS original_value,
    ROUND(latest_value, 2) AS revised_value,
    ROUND( (latest_value - value) * 100.0 / value, 2) AS pct_change
FROM annual_values
WHERE fiscal_year = 2021
  AND ABS(latest_value - value) / value > 0.05
ORDER BY pct_change DESC

WITH best AS (
    SELECT cik
    FROM companies
    WHERE name = 'Best Buy' OR ticker = 'BBY'
    LIMIT 1
),
cost_rev AS (
    SELECT av.value AS cost_of_revenue
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN best b ON av.cik = b.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'cost_of_revenue' 
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2023
),
inventory_vals AS (
    SELECT av.fiscal_year, av.value AS inventory
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN best b ON av.cik = b.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'inventory' 
      AND av.fiscal_year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(cost_rev.cost_of_revenue / ((inv2022.inventory + inv2023.inventory) / 2.0), 2) 
    AS inventory_turnover
FROM cost_rev
JOIN (SELECT inventory FROM inventory_vals WHERE fiscal_year = 2022) inv2022
JOIN (SELECT inventory FROM inventory_vals WHERE fiscal_year = 2023) inv2023

SELECT 
    f.fiscal_year AS "Fiscal Year",
    f.period_end   AS "Period End"
FROM filings AS f
JOIN companies AS c ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Foot Locker'
  AND f.form = '10-K'
  AND f.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2022
ORDER BY f.fiscal_year

    c.name AS company,
    av.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue
FROM companies AS c
JOIN annual_values AS av
    ON c.cik = av.cik
WHERE c.ticker = 'TSLA'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
